run_corpus_generator: run the script to generate seed corpus CSV from captured wireshark MySQL frames
compute_column_type: compute the MySQL column type from a wireshark field frame dictionary
generate_meta_block: generate a 2-byte meta block from a MySQL field frame with type and decimals
parse_text_row: parse a text-encoded MySQL row into individual field bytes by length prefix
generate_text_field_samples: generate text field fuzzer samples from a MySQL response and table name
